variant_title_en: Rule of Three — Distance and Time
title_en: Rule of Three — Distance and Time
story_theme_en: A car can travel 120 kilometers on a full tank of 45 liters. If you travel 240 kilometers, how much fuel do you need? If you have 30 liters of fuel, how far can you travel?
helper_tip: The ratio of distance to fuel is constant: 120/45 = 8/3 km per liter.
hint_th: อัตราส่วนคงที่: ระยะทาง/น้ำมัน = 120/45 กิโลเมตรต่อลิตร

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Ratio = 120/45 = 8/3 km/L | Fuel needed = 240 ÷ (8/3) = 90 liters | Distance = 30 × 8/3 = 80 km
